description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the instance **ID** on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must configure this parameter. If you do not set this parameter, the call fails.
>*   If your instance has no **Overview** page or ID, you do not need to set this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的设备记录数量，最大值是50。默认值是10。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
单次调用，最多可输入10个标签。
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
 > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
You can specify up to 10 labels in a single API call.  

## QPS limit  
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 5.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-device-by-tags --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --current-page 1 --page-size 10 --tag TagKey=room TagValue=101 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
